contradictions.fact: Which summit this route tops out on

claims.says: ...climbing toward Eldorado's famous narrow snow ridge and the 8,868-foot summit, typically another 3-5 hours.
IMPORTANT — this route is NOT on Eldorado Peak itself... continue traversing the Inspiration Glacier well past Eldorado's summit to Klawatti col

contradictions.why: The approach field first describes the route climbing to Eldorado's 8,868 ft summit, then immediately contradicts itself saying the route is NOT Eldorado and continues past its summit to Klawatti — while high_point_ft (8485) confirms Klawatti, not Eldorado, is this route's actual top.
contradictions.internal_resolution: high_point_ft (8485) and the route's own name/area confirm Klawatti is the summit; the first sentence's '8,868-foot summit' reference is the contaminated/incorrect claim, corrected later in the same field.

claims.says: Class 3 (Class 4 in spots)
Terrain is Class 3 scrambling throughout; retreat by reversing the ridge at any point...

contradictions.internal_resolution: approach_variants.baseFinding is the more detailed, route-specific source and explicitly documents the class-5 option; rock_grade/bail appear to understate the difficulty.
